cost_reporting.accounting_rule: The enclosing process time already includes episode CPU/wall work. Add only actual fixed action/first-encoding/terminal-delivery service fees once; never add full episode costs to the enclosing process time. Terminal delivery records a combined time tariff and does not support inventing separate CPU/wall measurements.
cost_reporting.scope_limit: The controller/feedback total is an observed research-scope cost, not total project cost or a deployment saving. Observer and native process meters are separate scopes. The native time-only value omits its fixed action-service fees. Provisioning, installation, infrastructure/acquisition fees, external transfers, archive/analysis/publication, supervisor startup before metering and some feedback startup/final serialization remain outside recorded scope.
cost_reporting.units: Registered normalized-utility tariff units; not currency.

limits: Publication integrity and passing CI establish file/chain/execution preservation, not semantic model quality or a globally optimal output portfolio.

Full raw output media and large pretrained feature/backbone files are not in the compact Git publication. Full Actions artifacts have limited retention; after expiration the compact cannot independently reopen omitted media.
The 19,688 count is physical trajectories, not independent quality samples. Repeated draws/configurations reuse development sources and all 24 native outputs replay development identities/RNG.
The trained tensor generator runs in Python/Torch under the unchanged Rust owner; this is not a port of the learned generator or actor into Rust.

The implementation is a finite-horizon gamma-2 exponential-utility specialization with approximate control, supervised anchoring and gradient clipping. It does not prove general recursive NDU optimality or solve a continuous Merton/HJB problem.
Only two training seeds and small widths are available. The source/seed bootstrap intervals are development estimates with limited seed diversity and finite-sample CE bias.

Observer candidate selection and reported OOF estimates share development data. Source grouping is by original video IDs; participant independence is not established. Fresh calibration sources were not consumed.

Original v1 mean-versus-mean mechanism controls were matched. The earlier native teacher-versus-ordinary comparison mixed objective/planner factors; new risk controls provide matched-risk operator/allocation comparisons.
The -0.005 noninferiority margin was frozen as a development-design value, not an established domain standard.
The analysis and this audit are post-execution products and do not modify registered source, train plans, acceptance thresholds or original evidence.
verification_method: Read GitHub commit metadata at the immutable evidence commit and verify its only parent equals the registered execution source.
Read INDEX and each of the six compact Git trees at the immutable evidence commit; all subtree responses report truncated=false.

For every remote compact file, compare its Git blob SHA-1 and byte count with the corresponding local original compact downloaded from the execution artifact. Verify original artifact ZIP SHA-256 digests against GitHub metadata.
Recompute compact MANIFEST.json SHA-256 against INDEX and compare original AUDIT.json against the audit embedded in INDEX.

Verify every stored-file SHA-256 and byte count against its compact manifest. Original-file and trajectory-chain semantic checks were performed in CI and separately by the complete-panel analysis; this publication audit does not reopen omitted media.
